title: A project check_command config key that scripted orchestrators run before review
boundary: **Not in this slice:** slicer running the command (it never executes it), a `relay-brief.md` placeholder for it, and setting a value for this repository.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
ork launches every role itself (ork review 2026-10-18, resolved as `launch.mode`), so it needs the project's check command to run before review. Today that command exists only as prose: in a project's AGENTS.md and in the ENVIRONMENT lines of its `relay-brief.md` template. A script cannot read it from either one.

Owner decision, 2026-10-18: `check_command` is a shell string, default `""`. slicer stores it and validates its type, `slicer config` reads and sets it, and `ai relay --json` and `ai relay-brief --json` expose it. slicer itself never runs it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/config.py`: the field, the string check in `validate`, `to_dict` (after `issues_repo`) and `from_dict`, following the `issues_repo` pattern.
- `src/slicer/cli.py` (`cmd_ai_relay`) and `src/slicer/ops.py` (`relay_brief`): add `check_command` to the payloads.
- `tests/test_config.py`, `tests/test_config_command.py`, `tests/test_ai.py`.
- `docs/configuration.md` (a row next to `issues_repo`), `docs/agents.md` (the `ai relay` and `ai relay-brief` rows), `CHANGELOG.md` under Added.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Config_CheckCommand_DefaultsEmptyAndRoundTrips`: a config without the key loads as `""`, and a set value survives `to_dict` and `from_dict`.
- `test_Config_CheckCommandNotString_IsConfigError`: a non-string value is a config error that names the key.
- `test_ConfigCommand_CheckCommand_SetsAndReads`: `slicer config check_command "make test"`, then `slicer config check_command` prints `make test`.
- `test_AiRelay_Json_CarriesCheckCommand`: `ai relay --json` carries `check_command` with the project's value, and `""` outside a project or when the key is unset.
- `test_AiRelayBrief_Json_CarriesCheckCommand`: `ai relay-brief --json` carries the same value.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Add the field, its check and its serialization, then the two payload keys.
3. Document the key in `docs/configuration.md`, including that slicer never runs it. Update `docs/agents.md` and CHANGELOG.
4. Mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
